```{r}
# Create 5km buffer (run once)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

ohi_regions_marine <- ohi_regions |>
  filter(location == "marine") |>
  st_union()

# Make a buffer ring
buffer_outer <- st_buffer(ohi_regions_marine, dist = 5000)
buffer_ring  <- st_difference(buffer_outer, ohi_regions_marine) |> st_make_valid()

# Union it to the marine OHI layer
ohi_marine_plus_5km <- st_union(ohi_regions_marine, buffer_ring)
```


We are using these layers to represent Saltmarshes:
-     VEGETACIÓN SECUNDARIA ARBUSTIVA DE VEGETACIÓN HALÓFILA 
-     VEGETACIÓN HALÓFILA


```{r}
# 1980-91
saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer <- saltmarsh_canabio_landuse_1980_91 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    descripcio %in% c(
      "VEGETACIÓN HALÓFILA",
      "VEGETACIÓN SECUNDARIA ARBUSTIVA DE VEGETACIÓN HALÓFILA"
    )
  )

# Match CRS of OHI and Buffer OHI regions
ohi_region <- st_transform(ohi_regions, st_crs(saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer))
ohi_marine_plus_5km <- st_transform(ohi_marine_plus_5km, st_crs(saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer))

saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer <- st_intersection(saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer, ohi_marine_plus_5km)

saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer_area <- st_intersection(saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer, ohi_region) |>
  group_by(rgn_id) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
    year = 1980
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r}
# Check for double counting
any(lengths(st_overlaps(saltmarsh_canabio_1980_91_sublayer)) > 0)
```

```{r}
# Combine all years into one long table

  saltmarsh_canabio_2005_sublayer_area,
  saltmarsh_canabio_2009_sublayer_area,

```


```{r}
# Pivot wider: regions on rows, years on columns
saltmarsh_wide <- saltmarsh_all_years |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = area_km2) |>
  dplyr::arrange(rgn_id)

# Make the kable
saltmarsh_wide |>
  kable( digits = 4,
    col.names = c(
      "Region ID", "1991", "2001", "2005", "2009", "2013", "2016", "2021")) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover")) |>
  add_header_above(
    c("5km Saltmarsh Extent (km2) CONABIO Land Use (All Years)" = 8))

```

# Extent: 2021
# This is the CONABIO Land use and vegetation data : http://www.conabio.gob.mx/informacion/gis/?vns=gis_root/usv/inegi/usv250s7gw
```{r}
# 2021
# Filter for saltmarsh classes in 2021 CONABIO land use data
saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer <- saltmarsh_canabio_landuse_2021 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    DESCRIPCIO %in% c(
      "VEGETACIÓN HALÓFILA HIDRÓFILA",
      "VEGETACIÓN SECUNDARIA ARBUSTIVA DE VEGETACIÓN HALÓFILA HIDRÓFILA"
    )
  )

# Match CRS of OHI and Buffer OHI regions
ohi_region <- st_transform(ohi_regions, st_crs(saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer))
ohi_marine_plus_5km <- st_transform(ohi_marine_plus_5km, st_crs(saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer))

saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer <- st_intersection(saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer, ohi_marine_plus_5km)

saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer_area <- st_intersection(saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer, ohi_region) |>
  group_by(rgn_id) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
    year = 2021
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry()

# Make a nice kable table
saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer_area |>
  mutate(rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id)) |>   # clean region labels
  select(rgn_id, year, area_km2) |>
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c('Region ID', 'Year', 'Extent (km²)'),
    align = c('c', 'c', 'r')
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c('striped', 'bordered', 'hover')
  ) |>
  add_header_above(
    c('Saltmarsh Extent (2021)' = 3)
  )

```




# Trend: 2021/2013

```{r}
# File 3: saltmarsh_trend.csv using CANABIO LU data
canabio_trend <- bind_rows(
  saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer_area,
  saltmarsh_canabio_2013_sublayer_area
) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = area_km2) |>
  mutate(
    trend = ((`2021` / `2013`)^(1/8) - 1) * 100,   # multiply by 100
    year = 2021,
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id)               # clean region labels
  ) |>
  select(rgn_id, year, trend)

canabio_trend |>
  kable(
    digits = 3,
    col.names = c('Region ID', 'Year', 'Trend (Annual % change)')
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c('striped', 'bordered', 'hover')
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c('Saltmarsh Trend' = 3))

```





# Condition

```{r}
# File 1: saltmarsh_condition using CANABIO LU data
saltmarsh_condition <- bind_rows(
  saltmarsh_canabio_2001_sublayer_area,
  saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer_area
) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = area_km2) |>
  mutate(
    condition = (`2021` / `2001`) * 100,   # multiply by 100
    condition = pmin(condition, 100),      # cap values > 100 at 100
    year = 2021,
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id)        # clean region labels
  ) |>
  select(rgn_id, year, condition)

saltmarsh_condition |>
  mutate(
    condition = ifelse(rgn_id == "Region 7" & is.na(condition), 100, condition)
  ) |>
  kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c('Region ID', 'Year', 'Change in Extent (2021/2001)')
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c('striped', 'bordered', 'hover')
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c('Saltmarsh Change in Extent' = 3))


```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_layout(
    #title = "Saltmarsh Extent (2021)",

    title.fontface = "bold",
    title.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
    frame = FALSE
  ) +

tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom"))

```
```{r}
saltmarsh_condition_clean <- saltmarsh_condition |>
  mutate(
    # FIX: restore underscores so join works
    rgn_id = gsub(" ", "_", rgn_id),

    # FIX: set Region_7 = 100
    condition = ifelse(rgn_id == "Region_7", 100, condition),

    # round for mapping
    condition_int = round(condition, 1)
  )

# 2. Join onto OHI polygons
ohi_saltmarsh_condition <- ohi_regions |>
  left_join(saltmarsh_condition_clean, by = "rgn_id")

# 3. Split marine vs land
ohi_marine <- ohi_saltmarsh_condition |> filter(location == "marine")
ohi_land   <- ohi_saltmarsh_condition |> filter(location == "land")

# 4. Plot
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(ohi_land) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "#f5e6c8",
    border.col = "gray40",
    lwd = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

tm_shape(ohi_marine) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "condition_int",
    palette = "RdYlGn",
    alpha = 0.7,
    title = "Current Status",
    border.col = "black",
    lwd = 1.2
  ) +

tm_layout(
  title = "Saltmarsh Current Status (2021)",
  frame = FALSE,
  legend.outside = TRUE
)

```
```{r}
# 1. Restore underscores + fix Region_7 BEFORE joining
saltmarsh_condition_clean <- saltmarsh_condition |>
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub(" ", "_", rgn_id),          # restore underscores
    condition = ifelse(rgn_id == "Region_7", 100, condition),
    condition = round(condition, 1)
  )

# 2. Join with region names + extents
saltmarsh_table <- saltmarsh_condition_clean |>
  left_join(
    ohi_regions |> 
      filter(location == "marine") |> 
      select(rgn_id, ecorgn),
    by = "rgn_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    saltmarsh_canabio_2021_sublayer_area |> 
      select(rgn_id, area_km2),
    by = "rgn_id"
  ) |>

  # 3. Clean labels AFTER join
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id),
    ecorgn = gsub("_", " ", ecorgn),

    ecorgn = case_when(
      rgn_id == "Region 2" ~ "Western Midriff Islands",
      rgn_id == "Region 5" ~ "Eastern Upper Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 6" ~ "Eastern Midriff Islands",
      rgn_id == "Region 7" ~ "Eastern Sonora Coast",
      rgn_id == "Region 8" ~ "Sinaloa Coast",
      rgn_id == "Region 9" ~ "Southeastern Gulf",
      TRUE ~ ecorgn
    ),

    area_km2 = round(area_km2, 1)
  ) |>

  # 4. Apply factor ordering AFTER cleaning labels
  mutate(
    rgn_id = factor(
      rgn_id,
      levels = c(
        "Region 2",
        "Region 5",
        "Region 6",
        "Region 7",   # <-- now correctly placed
        "Region 8",
        "Region 9"
      )
    )
  ) |>

  arrange(rgn_id) |>
  select(rgn_id, ecorgn, area_km2, condition)

saltmarsh_table |>
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Region ID", "Region Name", "Extent (km²)", "Current Status (%)")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c("Saltmarsh Current Status" = 4))

```
